description: Inject PullMD routing guidance for Codex and redirect Claude Code WebFetch calls to PullMD, with configured host exceptions and a per-URL escape hatch

hooks.command: bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [[ -z "$root" && -x ./hooks/scripts/session-start.sh ]]; then root=.; fi; if [[ -z "$root" && -x ./plugins/web-fetching-with-pullmd/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh ]]; then root=./plugins/web-fetching-with-pullmd; fi; if [[ -n "$root" ]]; then exec bash "$root/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh"; fi; cat >/dev/null; exit 0'
